summary:
## Standing operator rules
Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.

Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the wrong Canadian provincial tax calculation for Quebec (QST) in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Tracing work is superseded. Kafka repartition steps 1–3 are complete.

## Ruled-out approaches
Retrying all `HTTPStatusError`s; 4xx responses must fail immediately. Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours.

## Recent work
Optimized test fixtures; full suite passes: 318 passed, 4 skipped. Diagnosed intermittent invoice-sync 409s as concurrent duplicate submissions leaving idempotency records `processing`. Added a guarded completion update matching key and invoice ID, regression coverage, and stress-tested 200 requests: one completed row, correct replay, no 500s. Integration tests pass 8/8; unit tests pass 14/14. QST fix remains pending.
